body.zh: 从目标、规则、状态到奖励，梳理系统关系，整理说明文档与配置示例。
body.en: Break down goals, rules, states, and rewards into documentation and configuration examples.

body.zh: 围绕移动、跳跃与潜入，安排路线和挑战节奏，再结合游玩体验调整。
body.en: Shape routes and challenge pacing around movement, jumping, and stealth, then refine through play.

body.zh: 与程序、美术协作，也亲手实现功能；面对时间和资源约束，参与内容取舍。
body.en: Work with programmers and artists, implement features, and make scope decisions within production constraints.

title.zh:
《三角洲行动》
赛季任务系统拆解

category.zh: 系统拆解 / 个人研究

role.zh: 独立整理拆解文档、界面与配置示例
role.en: Independent analysis, UI documentation & configuration examples

summary.zh: 以 3×3 安全箱为核心奖励追求，梳理已有赛季任务系统的模块、规则、界面与配置关系。
summary.en: An analysis of the existing seasonal quest system, mapping modules, rules, UI states, and configuration around the 3×3 secure container reward.

scope.zh: 对游戏现有机制的学习拆解与文档还原。本人独立整理文档和配置示例。
scope.en: A personal study and reconstruction of the existing game system. I independently compiled the documentation and configuration examples.

title.zh: 先看目标，再看系统如何组织
title.en: Start with the goal, then map the system

body.zh: 围绕安全箱奖励追求，拆开四个模块，梳理主支线、阶段解锁、备用支线和多层奖励，理解不同任务如何共同组织玩家的赛季目标。
body.en: Starting with the secure container reward, I mapped the four modules, main and side quests, staged unlocks, fallback quests, and reward layers to understand how they organize seasonal goals.

title.zh: 把规则写到可以核对的粒度
title.en: Describe rules at a reviewable level

body.zh: 整理调查、击败、收集、撤离等行为对应的完成条件、约束、进度累计和失败判定；继续梳理委托分级、刷新、锁定和周期开放规则。
body.en: I documented completion conditions, constraints, progress accumulation, and failure rules for investigation, combat, collection, and extraction, then examined commission tiers, refresh, locking, and periodic availability.

title.zh: 从文档延伸到界面与配置

body.zh: 产出包括功能与界面说明、美术需求、任务表、任务完成条件类型表、奖励品质表和赛季表。通过按钮与任务状态、字段和示例之间的对应关系，让拆解内容更容易阅读和核对。
body.en: Deliverables include feature and UI notes, art requirements, a quest table, completion-condition types, reward quality, and season configuration. I connected interface states with fields and examples to make the analysis easier to inspect.

category.zh: TapTap 聚光灯 Game Jam / UE5

role.zh: 策划 · 玩法与关卡叙事 · 内容取舍
role.en: Game design · Gameplay & level narrative · Scope decisions

summary.zh: 用涂鸦、画册与色彩复苏连接场景解谜，把情感变化转成玩家可以参与的交互。
summary.en: Connecting environmental puzzles through drawing, a sketchbook, and color restoration, turning emotional change into player interaction.

scope.zh: 截至 2026.10.12 的制作记录：项目进行中；此处展示策划方案与已确认职责。
scope.en: Production record as of 12 Oct 2026: work in progress. This file presents the design plan and confirmed responsibilities.

body.zh: 围绕“涌现”主题，以涂鸦和画册为核心交互，策划通过场景解谜逐步展开的情感叙事，表现受创儿童重新理解家人与生活的过程。
body.en: Around the theme of emergence, the design uses drawing and a sketchbook as core interactions, unfolding an emotional narrative through environmental puzzles about a child reconnecting with family and life.

title.en: Use color to structure the experience

body.zh: 方案包含四段递进式情感关卡，以及蓝、绿、红三阶段色彩复苏机制；结合纸飞机、温室和餐桌等场景意象，让视觉变化对应玩法与叙事推进。
body.en: The plan includes four emotional stages and blue, green, and red color restoration. Paper planes, a greenhouse, and a dining table connect visual change with puzzles and narrative progression.

body.zh: 参与策划方案推进、版本记录与程序和美术协作，也参与过关卡内容删减，在叙事意图与实际可实现的范围之间调整方案。
body.en: I contributed to design implementation, version notes, and collaboration with programmers and artists. I also participated in cutting level content and adapting the plan to its feasible production scope.

role.zh: 关卡策划 · 设计与搭建

summary.zh: 围绕移动和跳跃，规划横版跑酷关卡的路线、平台与障碍，让挑战随行进逐步展开。
summary.en: Planning routes, platforms, and obstacles for side-scrolling platforming levels, with challenges unfolding through movement and jumping.

scope.zh: 团队合作项目，展示本人承担的关卡设计与搭建工作。
scope.en: A team project, presented through my responsibilities in level design and implementation.

body.zh: 以角色移动、跳跃为基础，规划关卡整体布局和玩家行进路线，安排平台与障碍配置，让每段空间服务于明确的操作挑战。
body.en: I planned layouts and player routes around movement and jumping, arranging platforms and obstacles so each space supports a clear interaction challenge.

body.zh: 考虑关卡难度递进与挑战节奏，在路线规划与内容搭建中处理跳跃、障碍和前进节奏的关系。
body.en: I considered difficulty progression and challenge pacing when designing routes and building content, balancing jumps, obstacles, and forward movement.

title.zh: 边搭建，边结合游玩调整

body.zh: 在 Unity 2D 中推进关卡搭建，根据实际游玩体验调整关卡结构，与程序、美术协同推进实现和优化。
body.en: I built level content in Unity 2D, adjusted structures based on hands-on play, and collaborated with programmers and artists on implementation and refinement.

role.zh: 玩法设计 · 关卡搭建 · 功能实现

summary.zh: 三条差异化潜入路线，连接巡逻、限时挑战与隐藏通道，形成“潜入—营救—撤离”的玩法循环。
summary.en: Three distinct infiltration routes combine patrols, time pressure, and hidden passages in an infiltrate–rescue–extract loop.

scope.zh: 腾讯游戏创作大赛作品，独立使用 Unity 2D 开发；AI NPC 是后续计划。
scope.en: A Tencent Game Creation Competition entry, developed independently in Unity 2D. AI NPC integration remains a future plan.

title.zh: 把潜入、营救与撤离连成循环

body.zh: 基于《九州缥缈录》世界观，独立开发横版潜入营救游戏，承担核心玩法设计、关卡搭建与功能实现。
body.en: Inspired by the world of Novoland: Eagle Flag, I independently designed and developed a side-scrolling stealth rescue game, covering core gameplay, levels, and features.

title.zh: 用三条路线承载不同挑战

body.zh: 设计三条差异化潜入路线，结合敌人巡逻、限时挑战和隐藏通道，围绕同一营救目标提供不同的行进选择与应对方式。
body.en: I designed three infiltration routes, combining enemy patrols, time limits, and hidden passages to offer different approaches to the same rescue objective.

title.zh: 在现有原型上继续探索

body.zh: 后续希望接入 AI NPC，实现动态对话与角色行为反馈。这部分属于未来探索方向，与已完成的玩法、关卡和功能实现分开记录。
body.en: I plan to explore AI NPC dialogue and behavioral feedback in future development. This is recorded separately from the implemented gameplay, levels, and features.
